body.x: E-reader Producer, Tianjin Jinke, Launches Various New Products at CES 2010 Expo in the US

LAS VEGAS, Jan. 6 /PRNewswire-Asia/ -- Tianjin Jinke Electronics System CoLtd, one of China's major manufacturers and designers of ePaper readingdevices, will launch several kinds of e-paper products at the consumertechnology tradeshow 2010 in Las Vegas, USA, after winning world-widepopularity for its V3 and V5 products.

New products to be presented include the V30+ equipped with 6-inch EINKdisplay and featuring 3G and touch-screen, and two new series -- A6 and A9.The A6 series adopts 6-inch Sipix ePaper display, and the A9 series adopts9-inch Sipix ePaper display, all with 16 levels of Grayscale display modes.

The A6 and A9 series, which are e-readers that for the first time in theworld have adopted 6-inch Sipix electronic paper display, will show userspictures more vividly. They are also available for 3G and Wifi-enabledcommunication devices and will enable online book purchases wherever they areat any time, as long as the signal is within reach.

The A6/A9 series products are equipped with user-friendly capacitive-typetouch screens, supporting multi-point touch, similar to the iPhone. Thekeyboard of the A6k/A9k products is designed with QWERTY style, which isconvenient for input and look-up.
It also brings users fun as the screen can be rotated in a circle, enabledby the 3-Axis accelerometer.
The products will be presented at eBooks TechZone in the Central Hall atthe 2010 CES Expo.
About Tianjin Jinke Electronics System Co Ltd

Jinke Company founded in 1985, is a high-tech joint-owned enterprise,which cooperates with Nankai University and the Hong Kong Proud Growth Group.Since 1999, Jinke began to devote itself to develop and manufacture electronicreading devices. Until now it has developed and designed many models ofelectronic reading devices. Jinke employs a professional design team; thereare more than 200 engineers in R&D department. Now Jinke has become a globalleading manufacturer and designer of ePaper reading devices. The companyoffers several business collaboration models including original designmanufacturing (ODM), original equipment manufacturing (OEM) as well as agentservices.
